title: Prepare and file statutory annual accounts
summary: Prepare the annual financial statements and complete the reporting obligations applicable to the entity and period.
outcomes: Approved annual financial statements with required distribution and filing evidence, and unresolved exceptions assigned.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: At the annual reporting close when the entity must prepare or distribute statutory financial statements.

parts.title: Reconcile the entity reporting facts
parts.guidance: Collect the reporting period, entity records, reconciled ledger, ownership and prior filings. List the intended recipients and evidence still missing; a completed bookkeeping close does not establish statutory reporting completion.

execution.rationale: Prepare local reporting evidence; authorized people own judgments, signatures and external filings.

geoResolutions.label: Reconcile the entity reporting facts
geoResolutions.guidance: Collect the reporting period, entity records, reconciled ledger, ownership and prior filings. List the intended recipients and evidence still missing; a completed bookkeeping close does not establish statutory reporting completion.

geoResolutions.label: Reconcile the entity reporting facts
geoResolutions.guidance: For the scoped active private company, reconcile the financial year, Companies House due date, HMRC accounting period and private accounting records. Dormant, group, charity or regulated accounts need another assessment.

parts.title: Confirm the reporting framework and obligations
parts.guidance: The qualified accounting owner confirms the applicable reporting framework, available filing regimes, audit requirement and deadlines for the actual entity. Keep uncertain eligibility or obligations open and obtain specialist advice before choosing a filing route.

execution.rationale: Prepare local reporting evidence; authorized people own judgments, signatures and external filings.

approval.scope: Confirm the reporting framework and obligations

geoResolutions.label: Confirm the reporting framework and obligations
geoResolutions.guidance: The qualified accounting owner confirms the applicable reporting framework, available filing regimes, audit requirement and deadlines for the actual entity. Keep uncertain eligibility or obligations open and obtain specialist advice before choosing a filing route.

geoResolutions.label: Confirm the reporting framework and obligations
geoResolutions.guidance: The accountant confirms the reporting framework, eligible accounts regime, required reports and audit position. Use the actual first or subsequent reporting period; unresolved eligibility and disclosure questions require professional review.

parts.title: Prepare the statements and supporting schedules
parts.guidance: Prepare statements, notes and reconciliations under the reviewed accounting instructions. Link balances to private records and identify judgments or omitted disclosures for the accountant rather than presenting a draft as approved accounts.

execution.rationale: Prepare local reporting evidence; authorized people own judgments, signatures and external filings.

geoResolutions.label: Prepare the statements and supporting schedules
geoResolutions.guidance: Prepare statements, notes and reconciliations under the reviewed accounting instructions. Link balances to private records and identify judgments or omitted disclosures for the accountant rather than presenting a draft as approved accounts.

geoResolutions.label: Prepare the statements and supporting schedules
geoResolutions.guidance: Prepare the statements, supporting notes and reconciliations required by the reviewed regime. Keep the private full accounts and the version permitted for filing aligned, with any differences explicitly approved.

parts.title: Approve and sign the final accounts
parts.guidance: The accountant and authorized corporate decision-makers review the complete statements and required signatures. Retain the approved version and resolve material errors before any submission or distribution.

execution.rationale: Prepare local reporting evidence; authorized people own judgments, signatures and external filings.

approval.scope: Approve and sign the final accounts

geoResolutions.label: Approve and sign the final accounts
geoResolutions.guidance: The accountant and authorized corporate decision-makers review the complete statements and required signatures. Retain the approved version and resolve material errors before any submission or distribution.

geoResolutions.label: Approve and sign the final accounts
geoResolutions.guidance: Obtain the required director approval and signature on the final statements. The accountant checks reporting completeness and resolves material issues before the authorized person approves distribution and filing.

parts.title: Distribute and file the approved statements
parts.guidance: Authorized operators use the applicable recipient and authority routes for the approved documents. Retain delivery evidence, submission references and any rejection; confirm the separate company-tax reporting work with its owner.

execution.rationale: Prepare local reporting evidence; authorized people own judgments, signatures and external filings.

approval.scope: Distribute and file the approved statements

geoResolutions.label: Distribute and file the approved statements
geoResolutions.guidance: Authorized operators use the applicable recipient and authority routes for the approved documents. Retain delivery evidence, submission references and any rejection; confirm the separate company-tax reporting work with its owner.

geoResolutions.label: Distribute and file the approved statements
geoResolutions.guidance: Use the authorized Companies House filing route and deliver the required approved statements to their recipients. Coordinate the separate HMRC Company Tax Return, retain each receipt and handle rejection as unfinished work.

parts.title: Verify acceptance and calendar the next reporting cycle
parts.guidance: Reconcile accepted filings and required recipient deliveries to the approved statements. Assign corrections and outstanding obligations, retain evidence, and record the next reporting dates without treating a submission attempt as acceptance.

execution.rationale: Prepare local reporting evidence; authorized people own judgments, signatures and external filings.

approval.scope: Verify acceptance and calendar the next reporting cycle

verify.how: Approved annual financial statements with required distribution and filing evidence, and unresolved exceptions assigned.

geoResolutions.label: Verify acceptance and calendar the next reporting cycle
geoResolutions.guidance: Reconcile accepted filings and required recipient deliveries to the approved statements. Assign corrections and outstanding obligations, retain evidence, and record the next reporting dates without treating a submission attempt as acceptance.

geoResolutions.label: Verify acceptance and calendar the next reporting cycle
geoResolutions.guidance: Verify accepted filing and recipient delivery against the approved accounts. Record remaining corrections, preserve the signed statements and calendar the next accounts and tax reporting obligations separately.
